route: C: permutation-invariant variable-camera observation/geometry-only warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v280: Independent error decomposition covers 1,404 opened virtual cells. Median signed contributions to field error are 82.27%–84.10% for inverse aliasing in clean data and 81.79%–88.41% for geometry mismatch under pose error. This is attribution, not improved reconstruction.
